mechanism_narrative: A surge in housing starts (HOUST) above 1600 units, indicating robust demand, boosts consumer confidence, leading to increased spending and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5d returns in > 50% of instances when HOUST > 1600.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month decline in the federal funds rate signals an easing monetary cycle that compresses discount rates applied to equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in easing periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: When unemployment (UNRATE) falls below 4.0%, signaling a tight labor market, wage pressures increase, driving inflation expectations and, consequently, negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60d returns in > 60% of instances when UNRATE < 4.0%.

mechanism_narrative: Industrial production (INDPRO) growth above 2% YoY indicates supply chain resilience, supporting positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days, but only during non-recessionary periods.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC for this interaction remains below 0.05 over any 1-year rolling window during non-recession periods.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp decline in retail sales (RSAFS) by more than 5% MoM signals decreased consumer spending, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5d returns in > 40% of instances when RSAFS declines > 5% MoM.

mechanism_narrative: The combination of rising FEDFUNDS and decreasing CPIAUCSL over a 3-month period indicates a successful inflation control, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward correlation between this interaction and SPX returns remains below 0.2 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Always-on: Positive payroll employment (PAYEMS) growth, indicating a strong labor market, supports positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.02 over any 1.5-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: GDP growth (GDPC1) above 3% YoY, combined with low unemployment (UNRATE < 5%), indicates a robust economy, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days, but only during periods of monetary easing.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC for this interaction remains below 0.04 over any 2-year rolling window during easing periods with strong growth.
